subject: Private deployment kickoff — on‑prem / air‑gapped availability & ops window
messages:
From: Tom Reynolds <tom@meadowhealth.com>

Cc: meadow-ops@meadowhealth.com

Subject: Private deploy deep-dive — can we lock an ops window?

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Meadow is excited to move to a private, air-gapped deployment for our PHI workloads. Before we commit to dates with our security/compliance team I want to get a short architecture deep-dive on the logistics: expected on-call coverage, firewall/IP allowlisting, jumpbox requirements, and an expected ops window (how many hours we should reserve).

Can you and the infra folks share availability next week (Oct 12–15) for a 60–90 minute session? We'd like your engineers and whoever owns the VPC/on‑prem checklist to join. Also sending over our initial requirements matrix as an attachment.

Key asks from our side:
- Confirm what prework Meadow needs to complete (network ACLs, KVM console access, vendor account provisioning)
- Time estimate for the main migration window and a best-effort on-call plan
- Any additional network rules or IP ranges required for pull updates

Attaching: meadow_requirement_matrix.xlsx

—Tom
Tom Reynolds
Head of Platform Operations | Meadow Health

Thanks,

Adding a couple of constraints from infra/security: 
- For air-gapped installs we need at least a 6 hour maintenance window for initial image bake and verification; if you plan to do switchover in the same window add +2 hours for validation.
- We will require a jumpbox pattern for protected subnets; we can provide a hardened AMI/container but Meadow must provision host-level access and an admin account.
- IP allowlist: we'll provide both service IPs and egress ranges. Meadow should allocate a CIDR block for internal test traffic that matches the matrix you already sent.

Prefer Oct 14 14:00 ET as well — gives us time to review the matrix. I've dropped a short ops checklist into the Drive link Priya mentioned (network firewall items and expected ports).

—Karthik

Couple of follow-ups from our side before the call:
- Can you confirm whether Redwood needs outbound HTTPS (443) during the initial pull/pipeline? If so, do you have a small set of FQDNs we should allow?

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-06T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deploy deep-dive — can we lock an ops window?

Tom — good questions. Short answers below, and I'll include details in the call doc: 
- Outbound: we require HTTPS for license verification and optional telemetry by default; we can provide a minimal FQDN list (6 hosts) and an IP fallback range if you prefer to allow by IP. I'll attach the host list to the Drive folder.
- Jumpbox: bastion + MFA is our standard recommendation for on-prem hardened installs; VPN+host key is acceptable for some customers but will require additional monitoring instrumentation. We'll cover trade-offs during the call.
- NTP and image signing: yes, we require time sync for certificate validation and recommend an internal NTP pool; image signing is part of our bake/verify process.

I've scheduled the session and sent a calendar invite for Oct 14, 2026 14:00 ET (60 minutes) — calendar link: https://calendar.redwood.com/meet/priya/2026-10-14-1400. Agenda (high level):
1) Introductions & goals (10m)
2) Network and allowlist review (15m)
3) Jumpbox and access patterns (15m)
4) Bake/verify, image signing, NTP (10m)
5) Next steps & ops window planning (10m)

Prework requested: please upload the completed allowlist template to the Drive folder at least 72 hours before the call.

Attachments: meeting-invite.ics (sent via calendar), link to Drive folder above.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Priya
